decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a low-cost variant close to the core offer and fits the firm's announced design-led direction, and as a 2023 launch any weak uptake can still be put down to the slow construction market.
This shower channel has its own web page and sits at the heart of the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy, so the visible commitment and development investment make keeping it very likely.

The pump-assisted solution took the most engineering investment and supports the announced innovation agenda, so management would persist and attribute slow adoption to installer learning curves and the weak building market.
The tileable floor drain is presented on its own page and is closely tied to the firm's design-and-tiling competence, so dropping it would contradict the firm's public positioning.
The stainless steel design grate is visibly promoted, uses the firm's own metal manufacturing, and embodies the design-led brand, so management would keep it despite any early weakness.
